details: Explicit schemes, integral and finite-field Groebner bases, dimensions/flatness/smooth loci, exact lift ambiguity and all requested modular parametrization images; the different scan41 fine scheme is treated in E.24.
Final scheme, precursor and norm-one factors are distinguished with explicit equations, inverse maps and dimension proofs.

Modular and formal dictionaries, quotient descent and finite models are established. B.16 and B.18 specify the remaining named geometric/normalized and restricted-conjugator comparisons at scans573–650 and651–690; these are distinct from B.8.5 and integral realization.

Universal matrix identities, used algebraic reading alternatives, quotient descent, central twists and restricted finite models are checked. The exact unverified global image/section and natural-comparison formulas are indexed in B.16/B.18; no exhaustive verification of them is claimed.
Precise existence/uniqueness theorem for inner pinning, arbitrary-base descent, infinitesimal projective stabilizer, and counterexample to unrestricted group-isomorphism uniqueness.
Complete normalized and projective classifications over every requested base, including imperfect fields; finite triples and GL2/SL2 projective orbits exhaustively enumerated.
Full affine coordinate rings and functors of points, including both ambient groups and preliminary solution spaces.
Integral monic Groebner certificate, QQ/F2/F3 computations, every fibre component and nilradical, smooth locus and unsigned/fine-parameter distinctions.

Modular and general formal exact sequences, quotient descent, central-twist kernel and corrected restricted antidiagonal are proved. The actual normalized sections and later natural-subgroup exact sequences are separately retained in B.16/B.18, with executed finite cases.
Exact ring-of-sections criterion, universal base-change criterion and smallest-cardinality Z/4 counterexample proved and executed.
Combined maps are isomorphisms over all rings; all missed individual points over finite requested rings listed; infinite integral complements specified exactly.
All p≤13 and n=4,8,9 counts computed twice and compared with exact formulas; unsigned and determinant-one companion counts retained.

Unsigned/signed formal constructions, congruence descent, global-sign pullback and finite tests are proved. Automatic realization (B.8.5), named geometric/normalized comparisons (B.16), restricted-conjugator comparisons (B.18), integral realization and D.7 are explicitly distinct residuals.
